options.reason: The table is a CPTAC-BRCA tumour proteome matrix with one row per sample and a single observed binary outcome, label (0 = 107, 1 = 15), i.e. HER2 status; the remaining ~12.6k columns are protein abundances of one homogeneous measurement type, so they are features rather than outcomes. Binary classification with the rare positive class is the task the table was assembled for, and per the workflow rails the default metric is left null so the workflow's rare-positive (precision-recall oriented) metric applies; discrimination, calibration and decision-curve analysis are reported downstream around that metric. sample_id is a row key only, and no column is a recoding, component or post-outcome derivative of label, so the leakage list is empty.
